items.text: Binance says it has covered 90% of its hack losses, having set aside $6.34B+ of company funds; the remaining 10% is in less liquid tokens. Cryptocurrency exchange Binance said on Saturday that it was able to cover 90% of the amount stolen during its recent hack.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.316 released
items.text: Added CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK, which turns the ultrathink keyword off · Added pooled group budgets to the Claude apps gateway: one monthly budget that a group's members share, on top of each member's own limit, set with pooled_budget on the spend limits admin API · Added CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP to keep system cross-certificates that certify each other in a loop, for servers whose private CA needs one · Added CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT to set the effort level subagents run at when nothing else names one, instead of inheriting the session's

items.title: We identified a security incident affecting a modified Claude Code VS Code extension accessed throu…
items.text: We identified a security incident affecting a modified Claude Code VS Code extension accessed through our Cursor IDE extension marketplace, impacting at most 5,000 users. This malicious version of the extension was not developed by Anthropic. It does not impact other extensions…
items.story: Anthropic says a malicious actor used access to Cursor's marketplace to publish a “tampered” copy of the Claude Code extension, which it didn't build or publish

items.text: BREAKING: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says having RAM in personal computers is an inefficient use of the world’s limited DRAM supply, arguing it would be better allocated to data centers, per Tom’s Hardware

items.title: Apple CEO John Ternus believes that, while AI can be useful, Apple products should continue to be d…
items.text: Apple CEO John Ternus believes that, while AI can be useful, Apple products should continue to be designed primarily by humans and not AI. "The creation of products is a deeply human and personal thing, something that we love to do."
items.story: John Ternus says Apple doesn't “want to ship AI for AI's sake” and that Tim Cook is “available to help wherever I ask” on policy; Ternus has yet to meet Trump

items.text: Seems token recovery already began. Another little detail in addition to the effort described, users pay trading fees on Binance in the coins they trade, so Binance's naturally accumulates all tokens they list. Your funds are SAFU!

items.text: 1/3 A CPU inside an LLM is one thing, but running another LLM inside an LLM would be taking things a bit too far, wouldn't it? Anyways, here's an LLM running inside an LLM : QwenPU, an LLM (@karpathy's stories260k) running on an NPU compiled inside Qwen 3.5-4B's weights.
items.story: An LLM inside an LLM - Same guy who put a RISK-V CPU inside Qwen has now made Karpathy's stories260k run on an NPU compiled inside Qwen 3.5-4B's weights
